visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: Each Product Overwrites the Last
visualizerParams.problemDescription: The product should be 2 8 / 16 10, but the program prints 0 0 / 15 6.

solution.explanation: Each entry is a sum of several products, so every product has to be added to the entry with +=. Plain assignment overwrites the entry, and only the product from the last k survives.
